build_R_Actor_network: build an R_Actor network for MAPPO with MLP base and optional RNN layers given observation and action spaces
build_R_Critic_network: build an R_Critic network for MAPPO with centralized observations and optional PopArt value normalization
run_R_Actor_forward: run the R_Actor forward pass to compute actions and log probabilities from observations and RNN states
run_R_Critic_forward: run the R_Critic forward pass to compute value function predictions from centralized observations and RNN states
test_R_Actor_evaluate_actions: test the R_Actor evaluate_actions method to compute log probabilities and entropy for given actions
